capture_note: IN_SCOPE capture: spread and game-total lines are priced body lines in the NFL intake grammar; entry = the lines lane's T-1H write, close = the final write (Capture Spec V1 per-game subset) -- no capture expansion required. The verdict is the preregistration's six-criterion test (research/nfl_entry_form_v2_20261028/PREREG_FINAL.md), gated SEPARATELY per market, not the framework's CLV-only default; per-market side semantics are governed by the preregistration and the family's evaluator adapter (sportsedge/nfl_entry_form_v2_evaluator.py), which refuses every counted entry point with EF_V2_FREEZE_NOT_AUTHORIZED until a freeze act records its pin. min_rows / min_events mirror the preregistration's own floors (section 5.1: >= 40 graded picks per market; section 6.3: accuracy kill evaluated at >= 40 priced games); the verdict review itself is per PREREG_FINAL section 4 (window close or kill), not a slate count, so min_slates is unset. PLACEMENT: this draft ships inside the research package, NOT in sportsedge/forward_validation/configs/, because (NFL, SPREAD) and (NFL, TOTAL) are already claimed there by the FREE_MODELS_GAME draft registrations (nfl_spread.json / nfl_total.json) and the registry audit refuses any second registration (DUPLICATE_FORWARD_MARKET_CONFIG, scripts/audit_cross_sport_accuracy_readiness.py). The freeze act installs this file at sportsedge/forward_validation/configs/nfl_entry_form_v2.json only after resolving that collision as FREEZE_ACT_CHECKLIST.md specifies. At the act, prereg_draft becomes prereg + prereg_sha256 and status flips to FROZEN; model_version and every gate value stay byte-identical.
